description: This PHP source file defines the TerminationReasonConfigurationService class, which manages termination reason entities within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for CRUD operations and querying termination reasons, acting as a service layer interfacing with the corresponding DAO.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationService
classes.description: Service class providing management operations for termination reasons, including creation, retrieval, deletion, and checks for existence.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the DAO object for termination reasons.

methods.name: setTerminationReasonDao
methods.description: Sets or replaces the DAO object for termination reasons.

methods.name: saveTerminationReason
methods.description: Saves a TerminationReason entity to the persistence layer.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonById
methods.description: Retrieves a TerminationReason by its ID.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonByName
methods.description: Retrieves a TerminationReason by its name.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Fetches a list of termination reasons based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonCount
methods.description: Counts termination reasons based on filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteTerminationReasons
methods.description: Deletes multiple termination reasons by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingTerminationReasonName
methods.description: Checks if a termination reason with the given name already exists.

methods.name: getReasonIdsInUse
methods.description: Returns IDs of termination reasons currently in use.
